decisions.reason: The source independently specifies links to products and related content, but a complete same-message MODIFY already represents that requirement change.
The image requirements do not change the obligation to produce three blog articles.
The source establishes the word-count requirement, but that requirement already has a complete same-message INTRODUCE Event.
The requested image, link, and word-count changes do not alter the existing client-approval gate.
The source changes article-content requirements but does not change the publication destination or publication unit.
Image quantity and retention do not change the AI-dolls blog's target audience.
The source does not add, remove, or replace any blog keyword target.
The blog image decision does not affect the website SEO keyword count or replacement keyword.
The source concerns blog content and does not change meta-title or meta-description optimization.
The source does not change approved webpage replacement terms or their replacement scope.
The blog image decision does not affect the requirement to include keyword search-volume data.
The source does not change backlink quantity, types, or distribution.
